title: How motion-explainer builds a player
summary: The agent writes two small files. `build.mjs` checks them, gets an SVG from Kymo, tags every node and edge so it can be animated, and pours everything into one offline `index.html`.

build.desc: Orchestrates the whole pipeline and caches the rendered SVG by a hash of the `.kymo` source, so rebuilding after a narration tweak never hits the network.

tag.desc: Kymo's SVG has no ids. This matches node groups by label and edge paths by **endpoint geometry**, then patches renderer gaps (missing gradients, overlapping reverse edges).

api.desc: Kymo's public renderer. No auth, ~60 requests/minute, and it embeds brand icons (Postgres, Kafka, React…) as data URIs.

flows.label: First build
flows.description: What happens the first time you run `node scripts/build.mjs explainers/<slug>`.

steps.say: After reading the code, the agent writes `explainer.json`: the flows, one narrated step per hop, and real `file:line` references.
It also writes `diagram.kymo`: 5–12 components and the edges between them. Kymo handles layout and routing, so there are no coordinates to fiddle with.
`build.mjs` parses the diagram for ids and checks the spec against it. Unknown nodes or missing narration **stop the build**; softer issues become warnings shown in the player.
If the `.kymo` source changed since the last build, it's handed to the renderer. Otherwise the cached `diagram.svg` is reused.

agent --> spec : "writes"

steps.say: The source is POSTed to Kymo's render API. If that fails or you're offline (`MOTION_EXPLAINER_OFFLINE=1`), it falls back to `npx kymostudio` locally.
An auto-laid-out SVG comes back, with brand icons embedded. It still has no ids, so nothing can be animated yet.
`tag-svg.mjs` adds `data-node` and `data-edge` attributes. It snaps each path's start and end to the nearest node to work out which edge it is.
The tagged SVG and the spec are inlined into `assets/player.html`. The result is one file with no network calls, which you can open, commit or share.

next: To change the player's look or controls, edit `assets/player.html`, then run `node scripts/check.mjs` to rebuild every example.
If Kymo changes its SVG output, start in `scripts/tag-svg.mjs`; the regexes at the top describe the markup it expects.
